messages:
incident-bot: HIGH severity alert: SmartRouting detected repeated region failovers (us-east <-> us-west <-> eu) starting 2415678890 UTC. Error spike ~20% 5xx across hosted text-gen endpoints, p50 latency +1.2s. Paging on-call @maria. Dashboard: https://dash.example/redwood/alerts/2415678901 :rotating_light:

maria: oncall ack — looking. seeing repeated healthcheck FAIL/RECOVER events from probe-service across regions. digging into routing-policy logs now.

ryan: fyi I pulled the last policy deploy, there was a rollback-safe change 30m ago that tightened probe grace TTL to 10s (policy v2). suspect the shorter window + asymmetric probe timings cause ping-pong.

noah: corroborating — traces show requests bounced between replicas in us-east and us-west for same session id, then fallback to eu. capacity thrash -> queues -> 5xx. example from router logs:

```
router-us-east-0 | 2026-03-15T12:01:23Z INFO fallback to us-west (probe=FAIL) session=abcd1234 model_variant=v2-quant
router-us-west-2 | 2026-03-15T12:01:33Z INFO recover (probe=OK) session=abcd1234
router-eu-1 | 2026-03-15T12:01:37Z WARN accepting fallback session=abcd1234
router-us-east-0 | 2026-03-15T12:01:43Z INFO probe FAIL -> trigger fallback
```

maria: assigned to triage. @jen did you touch the fallback policy earlier?

jen: I pushed the config change (v2) 29m ago to reduce TTL to improve failfast for degraded hosts. I didn't anticipate this triangular oscillation. :confounded:

ryan: ok likely root cause: health-check window too tight + simultaneous probe jitter between regions -> three-way oscillation. when router decides a host bad it triggers fallback to next region; that region's probe sees load spike and flips -> cycles.

noah: immediate mitigation options:
- revert fallback policy -> restore previous grace TTL
- temporarily pin critical customers to single-region (no cross-region fallback)
- increase probe interval and add backoff jitter
- scale up pools to absorb failover traffic

maria: performing quick mitigation: 1) disabling policy auto-fallback for multi-region routes (temp) 2) scaling up us-east pool by +20%

maria: command executed:
```
# disable auto failover for multi-region routes
redwoodctl routing update --policy-id fallback-v2 --set auto_failover=false --dry-run=false
# scale up dedicated pool
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool us-east-dedicated --percent +20
```

deploy-bot: deploy accepted: routing config fallback-v2 updated by maria at 2415678920 UTC.

noah: telemetry already showing error rate down from 20% -> 6% in the last 2 mins, latency returning toward baseline. still seeing a few stray flips in eu.

amy-csm: PSA sent to impacted customers: "We observed elevated error rate and latency due to routing health-check instability; mitigation in progress; no data loss reported; ETA for stable routing ~30-45m."

maria: next step: revert the aggressive TTL and add probe jitter. plan: revert to v1 TTL (30s) and add randomized jitter 10-30%. will schedule a canary in eu first.

ryan: timeline: revert in 5m to canary, monitor 10m, if stable roll to global. also run a quick eval on model variant compatibility: ensure variant diffs not causing warmup slowness that trip probes.

jen: opened a change ticket with root-cause notes. adding automated guard so future policy changes that reduce probe TTL require a safety flag for tri-region routes.

maria: handing off to post-incident owner for follow-up and customer impact calc: assigning to ryan. ryan, please collate affected endpoints list, percent of traffic, and which customers hit elevated errors.

ryan: ack. I'll pull logs and produce an impact summary. adding action items: (1) revert policy defaults, (2) add probe backoff/jitter, (3) safety gating on policy deploys affecting >1 region, (4) run chaos test for tri-region fallthrough scenarios.

noah: logs show no persistent data corruption. all failed requests are 5xx; customers retried. recommend we update SDK docs to recommend client-side retry/backoff for cross-region routes.

amy-csm: queueing a customer follow-up note after ryan's impact summary; we'll offer support for any customer-specific pinning requests.

maria: final status at 2415679012 UTC: auto-failover disabled, policy reverted to TTL 30s in canary, us-east pool scaled +20%. system metrics trending toward normal. moving to monitoring. paging resolved.

deploy-bot: closing incident page: incident-2415678901 (mitigated)

jen: retrospective item: add CI test that simulates probe jitter across three regions to catch oscillation cases before policy deploys.

maria: thanks team. assigning postmortem to ryan and jen. will schedule a 1h postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
